name: Dark Folk
body:
Source Pathfinder RPG Bestiary pg. 53
 This family represents a group of similar monsters. No official description was provided.
Members
Caligni (CR 1/2), Dark Caller (CR 5), Dark Champion (CR 5), Dark Creeper (CR 2), Dark Dancer (CR 1), Dark Empath (CR 2), Dark Slayer (CR 3), Dark Stalker (CR 4)
